# Spot My Business

## About

Spot My Business (SMB) is a digital presence and internet marketing service based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. The company helps local businesses establish, strengthen, and manage their visibility across the web, Google Search, Google Maps, and customer review platforms. SMB combines technical website development, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, Google Maps discovery, and reputation management to build verifiable digital trust and facilitate customer enquiries.

## Business Category

Primary Category:
- Internet Marketing Service

Legitimate Core Services:
- Local SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
- Google Business Profile Optimization & Management
- Google Maps SEO & Local Discovery
- Website Development & Design
- Website Management & Maintenance
- Website Performance & Mobile Optimization
- Website SEO & Technical On-Page Structure
- Reputation Management & Review Strategy
